story_text: As a user, I want to be prevented from registering with an already-used email so that duplicate accounts are avoided.

positive.title: Prevent registration with an already registered email
steps: 2. Enter a name, an email that is already registered, and a password.
positive.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating that the email is already in use, and the registration is not successful.

positive.title: Allow registration with a unique email
steps: 2. Enter a name, a unique email that is not registered, and a password.
positive.expected_result: The registration is successful, and the user is redirected to the welcome page.

negative.title: Incorrect error message displayed for duplicate email
steps: 2. Enter a name, an email that is already registered, and a password.
negative.expected_result: An incorrect error message is displayed (e.g., 'Password is too weak') instead of indicating that the email is already in use, leading to confusion for the user.

negative.title: System treats email as unique due to case sensitivity (e.g., USER vs user)
steps: 2. Enter a name, an email that is already registered but with different case (e.g., 'USER@EXAMPLE.COM'), and a password.
negative.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating that the email is already in use, and the registration is not successful.

negative.title: Backend fails to check for duplicate emails, allowing multiple accounts with the same email
steps: 2. Enter a name, an email that is already registered, and a password.
negative.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating that the email is already in use, and the registration is not successful.

edge.title: Register with duplicate email concurrently from multiple requests
steps: 1. Open multiple browser tabs or use a tool to send concurrent registration requests.
2. In each tab or request, enter a name, the same email that is already registered, and a password.
3. Click the 'Register' button in all tabs or send all requests simultaneously.
edge.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating that the email is already in use, and the registration is not successful.
